$comment: Region record (docs/DESIGN.md#regions-and-feeds). bbox: where this region's transit data applies (BC Transit's Fraser Valley systems, from just east of Aldergrove (-122.45, where Metro Vancouver's bbox ends, so they don't overlap) to Hope and Harrison Hot Springs. The 21 runs on to Aldergrove and the 66 to Lougheed Station, beyond it), [west, south, east, north]. initialBounds: the first view of /transit when the URL has no map position (Abbotsford and Mission to Chilliwack).
name: Fraser Valley
$feeds: The feeds whose transit it shows (config/feeds/<id>/feed.json).
$timezoneChecks: Known facts about this region's time zone that the runtime's time zone data (tzdata, via ICU) must agree with; the server refuses to start otherwise (checkTimezoneData in packages/transit-core/src/time.ts). Times are still always computed from the runtime's data, never from these. BC moved to permanent UTC-7 in 2026 (tzdata 2026b, https://data.iana.org/time-zones/tzdb/NEWS); older data falls back to UTC-8 on 2026-11-01.

timezoneChecks.reason: British Columbia's permanent UTC-7 (tzdata 2026b or later)
